title: 주간 생산량 추이 (3~8월)
code:
import numpy as np
try:
    patches = ax.patches
    xs = [p.get_x() + p.get_width()/2 for p in patches]
    ys = [p.get_height() for p in patches]
    if len(xs) > 0:
        xs_arr = np.array(xs)
        ys_arr = np.array(ys)
        m1 = np.mean(ys_arr[xs_arr <= 13])
        m2 = np.mean(ys_arr[xs_arr >= 14])
        ax.axhline(m1, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'1-13주 평균: {m1:.1f}')
        ax.axhline(m2, color='blue', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'14-26주 평균: {m2:.1f}')
        ax.legend(loc='upper right')
except Exception as e:
    print(e)
